scope: Reviewed withdrawal of two fixed-i386-disp32-v1 acceptances for a binding-construction defect, not a code or identity regression; instruction equality and the anchor itself are unaffected.

exe.host_02dd0.missing_link: The accepted binding (evidence/disp32_bindings_2026_10_27.json) pins core verifier code as reference evidence (scripts/match.py, scripts/fixed_disp32.py, scripts/masked.py, scripts/zero_storage.py), which would freeze the verifier, and its fixed-i386-disp32-v1 record pins a pending-interval snapshot that any newly staged EXE row invalidates (observed after re-pin batch 3, although no new pending row overlaps the anchor function 0x27f0-0x2b50). Withdrawn so the profile can check independence against the live ledger and the rows can be re-bound without verifier pins.
exe.host_02dd0.restore_strict_later: Re-promote with a corrected binding under the live-ledger profile check.
